name: DPC stake changes duplicate accrued reward quota
summary: DPC's stakeLp and claimStakeLp add getClaimQuota() to oldClaimQuota although getClaimQuota() already includes oldClaimQuota, so each stake change doubles the accrued airdrop credit. The attacker bought airdrop allotments, staked LP, looped claimStakeLp to inflate the credit, and drained DPC through claimDpcAirdrop.
notes: Anchored on the exploiter's first claimStakeLp loop (helper 0x2109bbec). Ordinary users' repeated stakes duplicated small credits earlier but redeemed nothing; only this exploiter's three claims drained material DPC.
changeIsClaim(true) only opened claiming, like an unpause, so the age runs from deployment. DPC has no price; it is valued at the 78,213.80 USDT the exploiter realised selling the claimed DPC.
